aligned topic-word cosine; reference collapsed to 13 live clusters. GSDMM cluster discovery is implementation-variance-sensitive (like HDP), so cross-impl agreement is inherently modest -- its parity gold uses self-consistency for this reason. Coherence-confirmed equal-or-better (#610): on the same corpus topica is more coherent every seed (c_npmi +0.093 vs ref +0.037, c_v 0.626 vs 0.506) and holds 20 meaningful clusters vs the reference's ~13; matched effective-K does not raise agreement, so it is which partition each sampler finds, not K. topica also follows Yin & Wang Eq. 4 exactly where rwalk/gsdmm drops the +j-1 term.

model: ETM (embedded topic model, Dieng et al. 2020)
note: aligned topic-word cosine, shared word2vec embeddings. Modest because topica's ETM uses variational-EM inference while the reference uses an amortized VAE -- same model family, different inference, so topic-word distributions diverge more than for exact-algorithm ports. Coherence-confirmed equal-or-better (#610): on the same corpus topica's coherence is on par or slightly higher (c_npmi -0.031 vs ref -0.050 winning 2/3 seeds, c_v 0.573 vs 0.527 winning 3/3) -- different topics, comparable quality, not a defect.
